node.statement: Scalar corner. The phrase one-dimensional images P_l means, by def-one-dimensional-delta-projection, that dim S^A_{P_l}=1; in particular dim S^A_{P_j,P_j}=1. Apply lem-maincb-nested-corner-dimension-transport to (R,P,Q)=(P_R,P_j,P_j). Node 1.2 supplies the t-projections, nonvanishing, both repeated left/right subordination bounds, A_R=S^A_{P_R}, and P_j^R=Co^A_{P_R}(P_j), while node 1.1 supplies t<=e_ncd. Therefore dim S^{A_R}_{P_j^R,P_j^R}=dim S^A_{P_j,P_j}=1, i.e. dim S^{A_R}_{P_j^R}=1.
